Good call, yes, they can still show up (and often do). The intent was only to avoid implying they are guaranteed everywhere. I’ve pushed a wording tweak to make that explicit: indicators can still appear, but are not guaranteed across all clients/modes.

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

This PR addresses documentation confusion about Memory Bank status indicators by clarifying that they may not appear in all clients or modes, while the Memory Bank itself can still be active.

**Changes:**
- Softened language from definitive statements to conditional statements about status indicator appearance
- Added a new paragraph explicitly explaining that status indicators are not guaranteed and providing alternative verification methods

title: docs: clarify memory bank status indicators
